title: Breach of Software Development Contract — TechVentures Inc. v. CloudBuild Solutions
facts: TechVentures Inc. entered into a software development contract with CloudBuild Solutions on January 15, 2025, for the delivery of a custom enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. The contract specified a delivery date of June 30, 2025, with a total fee of $450,000 payable in three milestones. TechVentures paid the first two milestones totaling $300,000. CloudBuild delivered a partial system on July 15, 2025, missing critical inventory management and financial reporting modules. TechVentures claims the delivered system is unusable without these modules and has suffered $200,000 in lost productivity. CloudBuild argues that TechVentures changed requirements mid-project, causing delays, and that the delivered modules meet the original specification. CloudBuild counterclaims $150,000 for the final milestone payment. Both parties have extensive email correspondence documenting requirement discussions.
supporting_materials: Contract dated January 15, 2025 with detailed specifications. Email chain from March-May 2025 showing requirement discussions. Independent technical assessment confirming missing modules. Financial records showing $200,000 productivity loss. CloudBuild's project status reports showing timeline slippage.
